title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Brand 9 Signs' own category goes agent-native — digital-signage CMS platforms now ship MCP servers (Screenly, Revel Digital, Korbyt)
bullets.summary: A year after zero production vendors, multiple production signage MCP servers are live; Korbyt's exposes media, players, content, schedules, users, analytics and data adapters as agent-callable tools, so an agent can push content, set schedules, and read player analytics by natural-language request.
bullets.how: This is B9's literal industry becoming operator-driven: a single Construct signage-ops agent can drive content + scheduling + player health across whichever CMS a client runs — the PRAGMA operator wedge applied directly to signage.

bullets.title: Runway ships a hosted MCP server routing its full generation stack (Gen-4.5, Seedance 2.0, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro) into Claude / Cursor / ChatGPT
bullets.summary: Pass a product URL, reference image, or text prompt in-conversation and get product images, hero assets, and marketing video without leaving the agent; one connector fans out to the whole model library by plan.
bullets.how: A first-class creative surface for Brand 9 Signs output; wire it into one Construct creative operator alongside the media MCPs already flagged (Higgsfield, VEED), don't run it as a standalone tool.

bullets.title: Pipedrive ships a native MCP server — live CRM read/write from Claude with permission-scoping and a full audit trail (Jun 30)
bullets.summary: AI assistants interact with live pipeline data in real time while respecting existing user permissions and logging every action performed.
bullets.how: A CRM-ops surface for the B9 / PRAGMA pipeline; adopt directly if we standardize on Pipedrive, otherwise treat permission-scoped + audited CRM MCP as the bar any CRM connector we wire in must clear.

bullets.title: arXiv: 'From Prompts to Contracts — Harness Engineering for Auditable Enterprise LLM Agents' (2607.08028)
bullets.summary: Reconstructs prompt-carried prototypes into a traceable, auditable agent architecture: deterministic behavior moves into code, manifests, schemas, and validation artifacts around a replaceable composition boundary.
bullets.how: The governance blueprint for The Construct's operator fleet: make each agent an auditable contract (manifest + schema + validation), not a prompt blob, so we can swap models/tools behind a stable boundary and prove what ran.

bullets.title: Frontier field stays seated — no new tier cleared the 24h bar; the cheap workhorses (OpenAI Luna post Jul 30 -80% cut, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Grok 4.5) hold
bullets.summary: Opus 5 (Jul 24) remains the newest reasoning tier; the everyday/bulk tiers keep repricing downward with no capability jump this cycle.
bullets.how: Routing math unchanged: hold Opus 5 for reasoning-heavy Construct jobs, route high-volume bulk to Luna/Flash; no top-tier switch to make.

praxis_lesson: The signals that matter this cycle are vertical, not frontier — Brand 9 Signs' own category (digital signage) has gone agent-native while the generation stack (Runway's full model library) is now one MCP call away. The Construct's move is to own the signage-ops + creative operator that drives both CMS platforms and the generation stack for clients, and to build it as an auditable harness-contract (per 2607.08028) rather than reselling any single vendor — the orchestration + governance layer is the defensible position, not the tool.
